title: A hierarchical sparse-grid particle method for the Vlasov--Poisson system
summary: We introduce a hierarchical sparse-grid (HSG) particle method for the numerical solution of the Vlasov--Poisson system. Sparse-grid PIC methods have so far been formulated within finite-difference frameworks, most notably through the sparse-grid combination technique (SGCT), which ties them to tensor-product Cartesian grids and globally defined component grids.
